banner.boss_down: The master of the zone has fallen
banner.core_open: The console of the Inner Core stands free.
boss.rust_worm.s: Tons of boiler plate and armour of bone.
boss.rust_worm.p2: The armour is torn off — acid blood sprays.
boss.dr_karel.p2: Hooked up to the transfusion machines.
boss.symbiote.s: Locked in wood, bone and metal, grown into the ceiling.
boss.weaver.s: A faceless being that weaves through the whole chamber.
boss.weaver.p2: Mirror phase: it fights in your style.
talk.worm.pre1: Boiler plate and bone... This is what guards the main valve. Watch its vents: wherever it aims, scalding steam bursts out a moment later.
talk.worm.mid1: Its armour is torn off — and it bleeds acid. Stay out of the pools!
talk.worm.win1: You were nothing but an oversized piston. Rest in the rust.
talk.karel.pre1: Ah, Vane... my erring colleague. Still fooling yourself with the sanctity of flesh? Come, let me operate that useless empathy out of you!
talk.karel.pre2: I came for the lift key, Karel. Not for your sermon.
talk.karel.mid1: So be it. Your blood will do just as well — my machines are thirsty!
talk.karel.win1: I have the key. Under the silk there was nothing but cogwheels.
talk.symb.pre1: Why do you fight the fusion, little doctor? We only restore what the machines tore apart.
talk.symb.mid1: Blood and copper spring from the same root!
talk.symb.mid2: Then I will cut it at the root.
talk.symb.win1: Nora's father worked in this garden. I hope it is quiet here now.
talk.weaver.pre1: It has no face. Only tentacles and hydraulic arms... This is what weaves the whole city.
talk.weaver.mid1: I see my own weapons in its hands. It moves the way I do.
talk.weaver.win1: The Weaver is paralysed. Only the console remains.
intro.1: Gorgona. A floating cylinder-city thousands of metres tall, high above the clouds — copper and bone, thick steam, hissing hydraulics, pulsing veins and rusted steel.
intro.2: The city was built around a God-Machine from an unknown age: the Inner Core. The Core gives lift, oxygen, power and artificial blood to every layer at once.
intro.3: Then the Core lost its balance. The Yellowing began: the coolant turned into infectious bio-steam. Below, the people mutated into monsters — above, the rulers hid behind mechanical armour to escape the rot.
intro.4: Vane was a master surgeon, cast out by the elite for refusing their unethical experiments. He died. Now his memories wake again in a mechanical-organic body, in a tank of the Operating Theatre.
intro.5: Descend from the top of the city to the Core at the very bottom. If you fall, the pattern of your nerves is kept in the Cone-Flask — and you begin again in a new body.
end.1: The core of the Grand Weaver is paralysed. Vane steps up to the console of the Inner Core. The machine opens: to keep the city alive it needs a fresh, beating, organic human heart.
end.2: “Not much is left in me of the man who once walked the corridors of the clinic. My hand is metal, my eye is glass, my lung is a copper filter. But this heart... this heart still remembered fear.”
end.3: Vane tears out his own heart and sets it into the sparking inner chamber of the Core. With a deep rumble the machine starts again. The rusty steam begins to clear; the purple and green poison-fires go out.
end.4: “Gorgona did not fall. The city floats on above the clouds. The people down in the sewers do not know it yet, but tonight the machine beats to the rhythm of a human heart. And as long as this heart beats... the city will live.”
end.5: The steaming towers of Gorgona slowly drift away. Somewhere behind them a clear, mechanical bell begins to toll.
npc.nora.role: Mechanic and smith  ·  works for Copper Alloy
hub.title: The Operating Theatre
hub.sub: After every death you wake here. From what you bring up from the Deep you can sew new organs onto the new body.
hub.nora.first: You are awake, Vane. The body is new, the memories are old. Bring me copper from the Deep and I will reinforce what I can.
hub.nora.idle: They brought you back in pieces again. Never mind — copper is patient, and so am I.
hub.nora.z1: Back again? I see the sewer rats chewed up your left thigh. I swapped it for a hardened copper cylinder. Next time try not to kick the steam valves! Bring me a Titanium rib and I will make you a chest plate that turns back buckshot.
hub.nora.z3: You have been to the Lung-Garden already? Be careful down there, Vane. My father worked in that garden when the steam broke loose. When he came back he no longer spoke... he only hissed, like a leaking boiler.
hub.nora.buy: Done. I tightened every bolt — do not smash it on the first boiler.
hub.nora.win: The steam has cleared... Do you hear it? The city beats to the rhythm of a heart. Yours.
hub.prophet.idle: Do not look at my skin, doctor. I gave it to the Weaver of my own will. I wanted to understand the melody the pipes are playing. Do you know what they say? They say Gorgona is not a city. Gorgona is a coffin that was built too high.
hub.prophet.buy: This heart-pump... shall I sew it into you? It will hurt. But pain is the only sign that proves your flesh has not yet turned wholly to rust.

journal.title: Journal
journal.missing: This page is still lying somewhere here: {0}.
note.hint: Enter: continue  ·  you can reread it in the Journal any time
note.n041.d: “The bio-steam is not a gas. It is billions of living micro-organisms that feed copper from the metal, and muscle tissue from the man, back into the system. Breathe it in and within three days your lung turns into a valve.”
note.sargulas.d: When the inner balance of the Core broke, the Yellowing began: the mixture of chemical and biological coolants turned into infectious bio-steam. The people of the lower levels mutated into monsters, while the rulers of the upper levels hid behind mechanical armour to escape the rot.
note.klinika.d: The Clinic was the place where the rich of the city tried to replace their organs with metal. The result was mass madness: the machines began to re-tailor each other, and the patients.
note.szike.d: “It was not designed for incisions. The butchers of the clinics used it when the patient had grown too hard from the implants.”
note.n112.d: “The Lung-Garden does not grow flowers. It makes oxygen for the Core, but when the structure is infected it breathes out pure poison instead of carbon dioxide.”
note.epeholyag.d: “An extract taken from the organ of the third level's mutants. Strong, but it eats at the stomach wall.” When hurt, its bearer spits acid on the enemies around.
note.istengep.d: Gorgona was built around a God-Machine from an unknown age: the Inner Core. The Core gives lift, oxygen, power and artificial blood to the layers of the city all at once. Whoever rules the Core rules the city.
note.idegfonat.d: “The biological nerves were replaced with fine copper wire. Reaction time drops to a thousandth of a second, but the heat is unbearable.” Doubles the speed and distance of the dash.
over.win.d: Tonight the machine beats to the rhythm of a human heart.
over.lose.d: Your memories return to the Cone-Flask. A new body waits in the Operating Theatre.

event.fogoly.d: In a rusty cage crouches a figure that is still half human. One cut would spring the lock — but its pockets are full, too.
event.fogoly.a: Set it free. (In thanks it gives you what it has.)
event.fogoly.b: Rob it. (Gold — but it will scream.)
event.verautomata.d: A clinic machine gapes its needles at you. Its display reads: “Donor required. In return: improvement.”
event.verautomata.a: Feed it your blood. (A new skill for a quarter of your max health.)
event.mutoasztal.d: The straps are whole, the instruments clean, fresh blood in the tank. Someone left an operation unfinished here. You could finish it — on yourself.
event.mutoasztal.a: Lie down. (Usually you grow stronger... sometimes you get infected.)
